builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-14: the players' own recruiting pages (profiles[]), one entry per volleyball registry team. Hudl's public team rosters for every school's girls volleyball teams, NCSA's women's volleyball school pages and a name search on NCSA, a SportsRecruits profile-address probe and MaxPreps' claimed career pages; each Hudl and NCSA page re-read by a second reader. No roster value is enriched by hand.
notes: profiles[] only: the players' own recruiting pages, linked by the rule of field hockey's file (lib/players/rosters-schema.ts PlayerProfileSchema): the page names the player and a sport, and either names the school or shows the roster's class year with a hometown in the school's own area. A volleyball profile names no sport; a profile in another sport does. No grade, height, number, position or coach is added by hand, and no school athletics site was swept.

2026-11-13, Hudl: every school's girls volleyball teams' public rosters (91 team-season rosters at the 40 schools Hudl lists; 23 schools have a non-empty one), matched by name, then each profile page read. Kept when the page's own team list has a volleyball team of the player's school and its class year, when shown, is the roster's. 75 rostered players have only private Hudl profiles; two pages state a class year that disagrees and are not linked.

2026-11-13, NCSA: the women's volleyball page of each of the 38 schools with players (45 pages), each matched athlete's page read. Kept when the page names the school and the roster's class year. Seven listed athletes' addresses were not found. Beach volleyball pages were not read.

2026-11-13, SportsRecruits: a profile-address probe in every sport for 870 of the 891 varsity and JV rows (4,472 addresses on my.sportsrecruits.com; 1,017 live pages, each read through the JSON the page itself loads; the kept ones read four times). About 530 live pages show at most a class year and are not linked. One page (a hyphenated surname's) was reached by the commitment-list sweep instead.
2026-11-13, MaxPreps: every row's career page read for MaxPreps' own claimed flag; a claimed page is linked as a MaxPreps profile (always the row's own careerUrl).
FieldLevel: 140 addresses probed at six schools and stopped; the four live pages show no school or class year, so none is linked.

2026-11-14, the 19 WCAL and WBAL schools: Hudl (18 of the 19 schools matched, Notre Dame San Jose not found; 77 team-season rosters at 16 schools, 59 with members; 206 of 208 public pages kept, two ruled out by class year; 52 matched players' profiles are private), a SportsRecruits address probe of the 379 named varsity and JV rows (1,747 addresses, 465 live pages, 45 kept; 133 state a class year that disagrees), every varsity row's MaxPreps career page for the claimed flag, and NCSA. A Hudl page whose name is a nickname or another spelling of the roster's (Momo for Momoko, Chin for Chinn) is kept when its school and class year agree, and its note says so.

2026-11-14, NCSA, all 60 schools: read through a headless browser (one page every few seconds, no login). The school pages list each athlete's exact address, but not every athlete, and an athlete address is global, so every named varsity and JV row was also looked up by name (the plain address, suffixes 1 and 2, and 3 to 6 where an earlier one was someone else's): 3,377 page loads. Kept when the page names the school and the roster's class year (two ungraded rows on the school alone); four pages spell the name differently (Olivia for Olive, Genevieve for Vivi, Sophia Rin for Rin, Thornton for Thorton) and their notes say so. Each kept page read in two runs that agree. 15 pages naming another school, or a class year that disagrees, are not linked.

Every Hudl and NCSA page linked was re-read by a second reader. The SportsRecruits and MaxPreps pages were read more than once by the pass that found them; the 2026-11-14 ones were also re-read at assembly by a separate script, which found each as the pass did.
